utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, the repair drive's all set. I'll bring it on Saturday—gotta put it to good use.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Saturday sounds perfect, Dane! I've already got my toolbox ready and some spare parts set aside. Can't wait to get stuck in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good to hear you're ready, Cleo. I'll swing by with the drive first thing Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center at 10 a.m. — come drop off your rusty tools!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That's right, and I heard Martha's even got a sign-up sheet for folks who want to learn how to fix things up themselves — real hands-on, you know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, I hadn't heard about Martha's sign-up sheet — that's great! I'll definitely put my name down for that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, I'm not organizing it, Ira. Vik here is the one spreading the word. I'm just trying to make sure it's the same one the Hendersons are running.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, it's this Saturday! The Hendersons are running it—I saw the flyer. I'm definitely bringing my toaster.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, so it's the Hendersons' event for sure? I just want to double-check before I dig out my old blender.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira, that would be great. I could definitely use a hammer and screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing, Nell. I'll pick up an extra hammer and screwdriver from the hardware store for you. Should I grab anything else while I'm there?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No, that's plenty, thanks. I really appreciate you going out of your way for me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, uh, Pia! The repair drive. Right. I think I've got an old lamp in the garage, but I'm not sure if it's worth fixing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Well, Oren, a lamp might not be on the main list, but let's not get sidetracked—we need to focus on the tools for the drive first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, of course, tools. I knew that. I just... where did I put my toolbox again?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Gus's tools would be perfect! We could set up a repair station for them this weekend if you're in, Uli.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, just tell me where to put them and I'll handle the sorting.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, let's meet at the community center at 9 on Saturday—I'll bring labels and we can start sorting everything out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah Sam, I double-checked my tool chest this morning—got wrenches, screwdrivers, and that voltmeter we might need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That's great, Gus! Sounds like we'll have everything covered for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet, Sam—I even threw in some spare fuses and electrical tape, just in case.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Jules! Just a heads up, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, thanks for the update, Rosa! Sunday at the community center works better for me—I'll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks Jules! I really appreciate you helping get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Morning, Leo! Glad you remembered the tools—I've cleared a table near the gate for them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. I'll bring the wrench set and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect! And don't forget the hammer Jules asked for—I'll make sure it gets to her.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey, Opal mentioned the repair drive is Saturday at 10. Just wanted to confirm I can drop off that old wrench set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's great you're joining in, Bo. I'm sure your wrench set will come in handy for the fence repairs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, no problem. I'll swing by Saturday morning with the wrenches.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Eli, tell me straight—do you think this repair drive will actually fix our street, or is it just window dressing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Mina, I'm a man who believes in doing things proper. If we stick to the plan and show up Saturday at nine, we'll get real results—not just talk.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, so you're saying it's solid. What exactly are we fixing first—the potholes or that busted streetlight?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, a community repair event? That sounds wonderful—I was thinking of a USB drive. So we're fixing things together, not just moving files around?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, a USB drive? I thought it was about repairing the community center? I'm getting confused again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, I see—so it's a repair event, not a drive. Let me check with Jules to make sure we're all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Kira, sorry I'm late—got caught up tinkering with that repair drive. You ready to fix some stuff this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hold on, Dane—you're talking about the same repair drive the Hendersons are organizing, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that's the one! Vik roped me into bringing it—said his ancient toaster needs saving.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Ira, we're fixing up the old community garden shed and some broken benches! Want to join the crew?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I can pitch in! I've got some extra paint and nails from the hardware store run.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, that's perfect! We're meeting at the shed at 9 AM Saturday—bring your tools and we'll make it shine!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, sorry Mina—repair drive? Is that happening this weekend or something?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, it's this weekend. But tell me straight—do you think it'll actually fix our street, or is it just window dressing?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I mean, I hope it'll fix things—but honestly, I'm still trying to figure out what you're fixing with a repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Alright, Gus, I'll take you up on that—let's check every item off my list right now.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, Pia—I've got my checklist right here and a few extra batteries I found in my shed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, good, Cleo—extra batteries are a relief. Let's sync our lists so nothing gets overlooked.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I think I remember something about that... or maybe I don't. What's it about again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s a neighborhood drive to fix that broken router at the community center. Jules asked me to bring a hammer for it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: A broken router? Hmm, I thought it was a lamp... but maybe I'm mixing things up again. I'll check my garage just in case.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Pia, I double-checked my toolbox this morning—got everything from screwdrivers to a multimeter, so we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh Gus, great that you're ready! Just a heads-up—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sunday works for me, Rosa—I'll just adjust my schedule and be there with the truck.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think I could help with the fence—I've got some spare time Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Rey! I'll be around too, so just give me a shout if you need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam. I'll let you know once I see what tools we'll need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: So Mara, I was thinking you could help spread the word about the repair drive—it's this weekend where we fix broken things instead of tossing them!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely! I'll tell the folks on Elm Street—and I'm already bringing my screwdriver set and that hammer you asked for.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks Mara! The event is Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4—I'll have a sign-up sheet there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Hana, quick question—you know if that repair drive is still going on? I've got some old junk I need to unload.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, there's two different repair drives—are you talking about the community repair event Jules mentioned, or the one for the router?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I dunno, probably the community one—honestly, just want to get rid of these rusty tools somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, Pia, what's the plan for this repair drive? I like to know the schedule ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Eli, I heard it's on Saturday at the community center. Everyone's been buzzing about it, but I'm not sure of the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I was told it starts at nine on Saturday. I'll be there with my toolbox ready to help with the sign-in table.
